measuredTextChanges.before: The learner can determine reaction enthalpies using chemically Hess's law and simple calorimetry approaches.
measuredTextChanges.proposed: The learner can determine reaction enthalpies using Hess's law and simple calorimetry approaches.

measuredTextChanges.before: Die lernende Person kann beschreiben, dass Wärme nicht vollständig in Arbeit umgewandelt werden kann, und Alltagsbegriffe wie Energieverbrauch und Energieverlust fachlich deuten.
measuredTextChanges.proposed: Die lernende Person kann die Grenzen der Umwandlung von Wärme in Arbeit bei zyklisch arbeitenden Wärmekraftmaschinen erklären und Alltagsbegriffe wie Energieverbrauch und Energieverlust fachlich deuten.
measuredTextChanges.reason: Specify cyclic heat-engine scope rather than imply heat can never be fully converted in an individual noncyclic process. Energy conservation and everyday interpretation retained.

measuredTextChanges.before: The learner can describe that heat cannot be completely converted into work and scientifically interpret everyday terms such as energy consumption and energy loss.
measuredTextChanges.proposed: The learner can explain the limits of converting heat into work in cyclic heat engines and scientifically interpret everyday terms such as energy consumption and energy loss.
measuredTextChanges.reason: Specify cyclic heat-engine scope rather than imply heat can never be fully converted in an individual noncyclic process. Energy conservation and everyday interpretation retained.
